lessons.name: Nol va bir
lessons.goal: Bola 0 va 1 raqamini taniydi, shaklini eslab qoladi, bitta narsani sanaydi
lessons.intro: Salom, do'stim! Men — Kabutar qushcha. Gu-gu! Bugun biz Raqamlar mamlakatiga sayohat qilamiz. U yerda har bir raqam — tirik qahramon! Birinchi bo'lib ikki do'st kutib turibdi. Ular kim ekan?

items.image_prompt: A round white egg shaped like the digit zero with a smiling face, empty basket nearby, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — nol raqami. Qarang, u xuddi yumaloq tuxumga o'xshaydi 🥚! Savatda birorta ham olma qolmasa, biz «nol» deymiz — hech narsa yo'q. Havoda barmog'ingiz bilan katta doira chizing — mana, nol!

items.image_prompt: One tall red pencil standing like the digit one with a small nose, one apple beside, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — bir raqami. U tik turgan askarga o'xshaydi: to'g'ri, ingichka, tepasida kichkina burni bor 📏. Bitta quyosh ☀️, bitta burun 👃 — hammasi bir! Barmog'ingizni tik ko'tarib ko'rsating.

tests.q: Savatda hech narsa yo'q 🧺. Nechta olma bor?
tests.why: To'g'ri! Hech narsa yo'q — bu nol.

tests.q: Qaysi raqam tik turgan askarga o'xshaydi? 💂
tests.why: Zo'r! Bir — to'g'ri, tik turgan askar.

extra.matn: Keling, birga kuylaymiz! «Nol — yumaloq tuxumcha, ichida hech narsa yo'q. Bir — tik turgan askarcha, burni tepaga qarab turibdi!» Endi nol deganda qo'lingiz bilan doira yasang, bir deganda tik turing!

lessons.name: Ikki va uch
lessons.goal: Bola 2 va 3 raqamlarini shaklidan taniydi va narsalarni uchgacha sanaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Kecha nol va bir bilan tanishdik. Bugun Raqamlar mamlakatining ko'lida ikki mehmon suzib yuribdi. Biri — oqqush, ikkinchisi — nimaga o'xshaydi? Keling, ko'ramiz!

items.image_prompt: A white swan on a lake shaped like the digit two, two ducklings, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — ikki raqami. U ko'lda suzayotgan oqqushga o'xshaydi 🦢: tepada egilgan bo'yni, pastda tekis qorni. Bizda ikkita ko'z 👀, ikkita qo'l bor. Ikkita barmoqni ko'rsating!

items.image_prompt: Digit three drawn like two round bellies of a snowman sideways, three balloons, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — uch raqami. Qarang, u yon tomondan ikki qorinchali qordonga o'xshaydi ⛄ — tepada bitta yarim doira, pastda yana bitta. Svetoforda uchta chiroq bor 🚦: qizil, sariq, yashil. Uchta barmoqni ko'rsating!

tests.q: Ko'lda oqqush suzyapti 🦢. Qaysi raqam oqqushga o'xshaydi?

tests.why: Zo'r! Bir, ikki, uch — uchta shar.

extra.matn: Men «ikki» desam — oqqushdek qo'llaringizni qanot qilib suzing. «Uch» desam — qordondek dumaloq bo'lib turing. «Bir» desam — askardek tik turing! Tayyormisiz? Ikki! Uch! Bir! Uch! Barakalla!

lessons.name: To'rt va besh
lessons.goal: Bola 4 va 5 raqamlarini taniydi, beshtagacha sanaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Raqamlar mamlakatida bir uycha bor. Uning oldida ag'darilgan stulcha yotibdi, eshik oldida esa shlyapali qorinchali bir bola turibdi. Ular — to'rt va besh raqamlari! Keling, tanishamiz.

items.image_prompt: Digit four looking like an upside-down chair, a cat with four paws, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — to'rt raqami. U oyog'i tepaga qaragan ag'darilgan stulchaga o'xshaydi 🪑. Mushukning to'rtta oyog'i bor 🐈, stolning ham to'rtta oyog'i bor. To'rtta barmoqni ko'rsating!

items.image_prompt: Digit five as a chubby boy with a flat hat, an open hand with five fingers, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — besh raqami. U tepasida tekis shlyapa kiygan, qorni dumaloq bolaga o'xshaydi 🎩. Bir qo'limizda beshta barmoq bor ✋. Qo'lingizni oching va sanang: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh!

extra.matn: Qo'lingizni ko'taring va har barmoqni bukib kuylang: «Bir — katta barmoq, ikki — ko'rsatkich, uch — o'rtancha, to'rt — nomsiz, besh — jimjiloq! Beshta barmoq — bir qo'l, qarsak chalib o'ynaymiz!» Endi qarsak chaling: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh!

lessons.name: Beshgacha sanaymiz
lessons.goal: Bola 0 dan 5 gacha sanaydi, sonni narsalar soni bilan moslaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Nol, bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh — hammasi yig'ilishdi! Ular saf tortib turishibdi. Lekin bitta sir bor: to'g'ri sanash uchun maxsus qoida bor ekan. Qanday qoida? Hozir bilamiz!

items.image_prompt: A child finger pointing at apples one by one while counting, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sanayotganda har bir narsani barmoq bilan bir marta ko'rsatamiz 👉. Birorta ham narsani tashlab ketmaymiz, ikki marta ham sanamaymiz. Oxirgi aytgan sonimiz — hammasi nechta ekanini bildiradi. Masalan: 🍎🍎🍎 — bir, ikki, uch. Uchta olma!

items.image_prompt: Digits zero to five standing in a line like friends holding hands, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Raqamlar doim bir tartibda saf tortadi: nol, bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh. Har bir keyingi raqam bittaga ko'p. Qadam tashlab sanang: har qadamda bitta son!

tests.why: To'g'ri! Bir, ikki, uch, to'rt — to'rtta baliq.

tests.q: Qatorda 2 dan keyin qaysi raqam turadi?
tests.why: Ofarin! Bir, ikki, uch — 2 dan keyin 3.

extra.matn: Men raqam aytaman, siz shuncha marta qarsak chalasiz! Uch — 👏👏👏. To'rt! Bir! Besh! Nol — hech qarsak chalmaymiz, jim turamiz! Qoyil, siz haqiqiy sanoq ustasisiz!

lessons.name: Olti va yetti
lessons.goal: Bola 6 va 7 raqamlarini shaklidan taniydi va yettigacha sanaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Raqamlar mamlakatida bog' bor. Bog'da bir salyangoz o'rmalab yuribdi, yonida esa egilgan chiroq ustuni turibdi. Bilasizmi, ular ham raqamlar! Kim ekan?

items.image_prompt: A snail with round shell shaped like digit six, six ladybugs, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — olti raqami. U salyangozga o'xshaydi 🐌: pastda dumaloq uychasi, tepaga esa boshini cho'zib turibdi. Besh barmoq va yana bitta barmoq — olti bo'ladi. Qarang: ✋☝️ — oltita!
items.action: Besh va yana bitta barmoqni ko'rsating!

items.image_prompt: A bent street lamp shaped like digit seven, seven colors of rainbow, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — yetti raqami. U boshini egib turgan ko'cha chirog'iga o'xshaydi 🏮: tepada ko'ndalang chiziq, pastga qiyshiq ustun. Kamalakda yettita rang bor 🌈. Haftada ham yetti kun bor!

tests.q: Qaysi raqam egilgan chiroq ustuniga o'xshaydi? 🏮

extra.matn: Men «olti» desam — salyangozdek cho'nqayib, boshingizni ko'taring. «Yetti» desam — chiroqdek tik turib, boshingizni egib qo'ying. Olti! Yetti! Olti! Endi sekin sanaymiz: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh, olti, yetti — va qarsak!

lessons.name: Sakkiz va to'qqiz
lessons.goal: Bola 8 va 9 raqamlarini taniydi, 6 va 9 ni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Qish keldi, Raqamlar mamlakatiga qor yog'di. Bolalar ikki dumaloq qor koptokdan qordon yasashdi. Yonida esa ipli sharcha uchib yuribdi. Bular — sakkiz va to'qqiz!

items.image_prompt: A snowman made of two round snowballs shaped like digit eight, octopus, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — sakkiz raqami. U ikki dumaloq qor koptokdan yasalgan qordonga o'xshaydi ⛄: tepada kichik halqa, pastda katta halqa. Sakkizoyoqning sakkizta oyog'i bor 🐙. Havoda sakkiz chizing — to'xtamasdan aylantiring!

items.image_prompt: A balloon on a string shaped like digit nine, nine small stars, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — to'qqiz raqami. U ipga bog'langan sharchaga o'xshaydi 🎈: tepada dumaloq shar, pastga ip tushib turibdi. Oltini teskari ag'darsak — to'qqiz bo'ladi! Olti salyangozdek pastda dumaloq, to'qqiz esa tepada dumaloq.

tests.q: Qaysi raqamning dumalog'i tepada, ipi pastda? 🎈

extra.matn: Qog'ozga 6 raqamini yozing va uni teskari aylantiring — nima bo'ldi? To'qqiz! Salyangoz sharchaga aylandi. Esda tuting: dumalog'i pastda — olti, dumalog'i tepada — to'qqiz.

lessons.name: O'n soni
lessons.goal: Bola 10 ni ikki raqamdan (1 va 0) iborat son sifatida taniydi, o'ntagacha sanaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Raqamlar mamlakatida bayram! Bir va nol qo'l ushlashib, yonma-yon turishdi — va yangi son paydo bo'ldi. Bu qanday son ekan? Keling, barmoqlarimiz bilan bilib olamiz!

items.image_prompt: Digit one and digit zero holding hands like friends, ten fingers of two hands, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — o'n soni. Unda ikki raqam bor: oldin bir, keyin nol 1️⃣0️⃣. Askarcha va tuxumcha yonma-yon turib, o'nni yasashdi! Ikki qo'limizda jami o'nta barmoq bor 🙌.

items.image_prompt: Ten colorful balloons in a row with digits one to ten, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Endi biz o'ngacha sanay olamiz: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh, olti, yetti, sakkiz, to'qqiz, o'n! Har bir son oldingisidan bittaga ko'p. Barmoqlarni bittadan ochib sanang.

tests.why: Barakalla! Oldin bir, keyin nol — o'n.

extra.matn: Kuylaymiz va barmoqni bittadan ochamiz: «Bir, ikki — qo'l ko'taring, uch, to'rt — qarsak chaling, besh, olti — sakrang bir bor, yetti, sakkiz — aylaning, to'qqiz, o'n — ta'zim qiling, sanoqni yaxshi bilamiz!»

lessons.name: Ko'p, kam, teng
lessons.goal: Bola ikki guruhni sanab solishtiradi: qayerda ko'p, qayerda kam, qayerda teng
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Ikki sincap yong'oq terishdi. Birinchisi aytadi: «Menda ko'p!» Ikkinchisi aytadi: «Yo'q, menda ko'p!» Kim haq? Keling, sanab ko'ramiz va ularni yarashtiramiz.

items.image_prompt: A basket full of five red apples next to a basket with two apples, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ikki guruhni sanaymiz. Qaysi birida son katta bo'lsa — o'sha yerda ko'p. 🍎🍎🍎🍎🍎 — beshta, 🍎🍎 — ikkita. Besh ikkidan katta, demak birinchi savatda ko'p!

items.image_prompt: A small basket with only two red apples, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qaysi guruhda son kichik bo'lsa — o'sha yerda kam. 🐤🐤🐤 — uchta, 🐤 — bitta. Bir uchdan kichik, demak bitta jo'ja bor joyda kam.

items.image_prompt: Two plates each with three cookies, balanced scale, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Agar ikki guruhda son bir xil bo'lsa — ular teng. 🍪🍪🍪 va 🍪🍪🍪 — uchta va uchta. Hech kimda ko'p ham, kam ham emas — teng! Endi sincaplar yarashadi.

tests.q: Sincap 🐿️ 7 ta yong'oq terdi, boshqasi 🐿️ 9 ta. Kimda ko'p?

lessons.name: Beshdan orqaga
lessons.goal: Bola 5 dan 0 gacha orqaga sanaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bugun biz kosmonavt bo'lamiz! Raketamiz uchishga tayyor. Lekin raketa uchishi uchun orqaga sanash kerak. Bu qanday sanash ekan? Kamarni taqing!

items.image_prompt: Digits five four three two one standing in a line going down stairs, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Odatda biz oldinga sanaymiz: bir, ikki, uch. Orqaga sanaganda esa katta sondan boshlab, har safar bittaga kamaytiramiz: besh, to'rt, uch, ikki, bir. Xuddi zinadan pastga tushgandek 🪜!

items.image_prompt: A small rocket launching with fire, digit zero on it, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Orqaga sanash nolga yetganda tugaydi. Raketa aytadi: besh, to'rt, uch, ikki, bir, nol — uchdik! 🚀 Nol — eng kichik son, undan pastga tushmaymiz.

tests.q: Orqaga sanaganda 3 dan keyin qaysi son?
Orqaga sanash qaysi songa yetib tugaydi?

extra.matn: Cho'nqayib o'tiring — siz raketasiz! Men bilan orqaga sanang va har sonda bir oz ko'tariling: besh, to'rt, uch, ikki, bir... NOL! Sakrab, qo'llarni tepaga cho'zing — uchdik! 🚀 Yana bir marta!

lessons.name: O'ndan orqaga
lessons.goal: Bola 10 dan 0 gacha orqaga sanaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Kechagi raketamiz kichkina edi. Bugun katta raketa — u uzoq sayyoraga uchadi! Unga beshdan emas, o'ndan orqaga sanash kerak. Tayyormisiz, kosmonavtlar?

items.image_prompt: Big rocket with digits ten to zero along its side, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Endi o'ndan boshlaymiz: o'n, to'qqiz, sakkiz, yetti, olti, besh, to'rt, uch, ikki, bir, nol! Har qadamda bitta son kamayadi. Barmoqlarni bittadan bukib sanang 🙌.

items.image_prompt: A plate of cookies with one cookie being taken away, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Orqaga sanaganda har bir son oldingisidan bittaga kam. Likopchada 🍪🍪🍪🍪 to'rtta pechenye bor. Bittasini yesak — uchta qoladi. To'rtdan keyin orqaga — uch!

tests.q: Orqaga sanaganda 6 dan keyin qaysi son?
🍪🍪🍪🍪🍪 beshta pechenye. Bittasini yedik. Nechta qoldi?

extra.matn: «O'nta chumchuq shoxda o'tirar, bittasi uchib ketdi — pirr! Endi to'qqiz chumchuq qoldi...» Har safar bittasi uchadi: sakkiz, yetti, olti... oxirida nol — shox bo'm-bo'sh! Qo'lingizni qanot qilib, har «pirr»da silkiting.

lessons.name: Oldingi va keyingi son
lessons.goal: Bola sonning qo'shnilarini — oldingi (bittaga kam) va keyingi (bittaga ko'p) sonni topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Raqamlar ko'chasida uylar qatorlashib turibdi. Har bir sonning ikki qo'shnisi bor: biri chap tomonda, biri o'ng tomonda yashaydi. Keling, ular bilan tanishamiz!

items.image_prompt: Houses in a row numbered, arrow pointing to the right neighbor, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Keyingi son — sanaganda darhol keyin keladigan son. U bittaga ko'p. 4 ning keyingisi — 5, chunki to'rt, keyin besh. 🐤🐤🐤🐤 ga yana bitta jo'ja kelsa — beshta bo'ladi!

items.image_prompt: Houses in a row numbered, arrow pointing to the left neighbor, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Oldingi son — sanaganda oldin keladigan son. U bittaga kam. 4 ning oldingisi — 3. Orqaga sanashni eslang: to'rt, keyin uch!

items.image_prompt: Three houses side by side with digits three four five on doors, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Har bir sonning ikki qo'shnisi bor: oldingi va keyingi. 5 ning qo'shnilari — 4 va 6. Nolning faqat bitta qo'shnisi bor — 1, chunki noldan kichik son yo'q.

tests.why: Barakalla! Yetti, keyin sakkiz — demak oldingisi yetti.
Ofarin! Ikki va to'rt — uchning qo'shnilari.

extra.matn: Men son aytaman — siz uning qo'shnilarini aytasiz! Chap qo'lni ko'tarib oldingisini, o'ng qo'lni ko'tarib keyingisini ayting. Besh! — To'rt va olti! Ikki! — Bir va uch! Sakkiz! — Yetti va to'qqiz! Barakalla!

lessons.name: Tushib qolgan son
lessons.goal: Bola sonlar qatoridagi bo'sh joyni qo'shni sonlar yordamida topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Voy, shamol esdi-yu, sonlar qatoridan bitta son uchib ketdi! Endi qatorda bo'sh joy qoldi. Kim yordam beradi? Qo'shnilar bizga yo'l ko'rsatadi!

items.image_prompt: A row of number cards with one empty card with a question mark, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qatorga qarang: 1, 2, ❓, 4. Bo'sh joy ikki bilan to'rtning orasida. Ikkining keyingisi — uch! Demak, tushib qolgan son — 3.

items.image_prompt: Three friends holding hands, the one in the middle smiling, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Agar ikki sonning orasida bitta joy bo'lsa, u yerda o'rtadagi son turadi. 6 va 8 ning o'rtasida — 7. Sanab tekshiring: olti, yetti, sakkiz. To'g'ri!

tests.why: To'g'ri! To'rt va olti orasida — besh.

lessons.name: Uch, to'rt va besh uychasi
lessons.goal: Bola 3, 4, 5 sonlarini ikki kichik songa ajratadi (5 — bu 2 va 3)
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Har bir sonning ikki qavatli uychasi bor. Uychada ikki xona: chap xonada bir nechta mehmon, o'ng xonada qolgani yashaydi. Hammasi birga — shu son! Keling, uychalarga mehmon joylaymiz.

items.image_prompt: A small house with two rooms, one ball in the left room and two balls in the right, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Uchta sharni ikki xonaga bo'lamiz: chapda bitta 🔴, o'ngda ikkita 🔴🔴. Bir va ikki — birga uch! Demak, 3 — bu 1 va 2.

items.image_prompt: A house with two rooms holding two bunnies each, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: To'rtta quyonchani joylaymiz 🐰. Chapda bitta, o'ngda uchta — to'rt. Yoki chapda ikkita, o'ngda ikkita — yana to'rt! 4 — bu 1 va 3, yoki 2 va 2.

items.image_prompt: One hand with two fingers bent and three fingers up, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Beshta barmoqni ko'rsating ✋. Ikkitasini buking — uchtasi ochiq qoldi. Ikki va uch — besh! Yana: bir va to'rt ham besh bo'ladi. 5 — bu 2 va 3, yoki 1 va 4.

tests.q: Qo'lda 5 barmoq. 1 tasi bukildi. Nechta ochiq? ✋
tests.why: Zo'r! Besh — bu bir va to'rt.

extra.matn: Men bir qo'limni ko'rsataman: beshta barmoq. Endi bir nechtasini orqaga yashiraman. Ekranda ikkitasi ko'rinib turibdi — nechtasi yashiringan? Uchta! Chunki besh — bu ikki va uch. Endi siz ham ota-onangiz bilan o'ynang!

lessons.name: Olti va yetti uychasi
lessons.goal: Bola 6 va 7 sonlarining tarkibini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Olti va yetti ham uycha qurishdi. Ularning mehmonlari ko'proq — kapalaklar va qo'ng'izchalar. Kim qaysi xonaga kiradi? Keling, joylaymiz!

items.image_prompt: Two flowers, one with two butterflies and one with four butterflies, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Oltita kapalak 🦋 ikki gulga qo'ndi. Birinchi gulda ikkita, ikkinchisida to'rtta — hammasi olti. Yoki uchta va uchta — yana olti! 6 — bu 2 va 4, 3 va 3, yoki 1 va 5.

items.image_prompt: Two leaves with ladybugs, three on one and four on the other, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yettita qo'ng'iz 🐞 ikki bargga chiqdi: bittasida uchta, boshqasida to'rtta. Uch va to'rt — yetti! Yoki bir qo'lda besh barmoq, ikkinchisida ikki barmoq ✋✌️ — yana yetti.

extra.matn: «Olti kapalak uchib keldi, ikki gulga qo'nib oldi. Uchtasi bu gulda, uchtasi u gulda — hammasi olti, to'g'ri emasmi?» Endi qo'llaringizni kapalak qanotidek silkitib, ikki guruhga bo'linib uching!

lessons.name: Sakkiz va to'qqiz uychasi
lessons.goal: Bola 8 va 9 sonlarining tarkibini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bugun ikki katta uycha: sakkiz va to'qqiz. Ularga baliqchalar va yulduzchalar mehmonga kelishdi. Akvarium va osmonga bo'lib joylaymiz!

items.image_prompt: Two aquariums, four fish in each, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sakkizta baliq 🐟 ikki akvariumga bo'lindi: to'rtta va to'rtta. Hammasi sakkiz! Yoki beshta va uchta — yana sakkiz. 8 — bu 4 va 4, yoki 5 va 3.

items.image_prompt: Night sky with five stars on one side and four stars on the other, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square

items.explain: O'nning do'st juftlari: 1 va 9, 2 va 8, 3 va 7, 4 va 6, 5 va 5. Ikki qo'lni oching 🙌 — o'nta barmoq. Uchtasini buking — yettita ochiq. Uch va yetti — o'n!

items.image_prompt: Two hands with five fingers each, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Eng oson do'stlar — besh va besh. Bir qo'lda besh, ikkinchi qo'lda besh — o'n! O'nni doim ikki qo'lingizda ko'rasiz 🙌.

extra.matn: Men son aytaman — siz o'nga yetishmaganini aytasiz! Men: sakkiz! Siz: ikki! Men: bir! Siz: to'qqiz! Men: olti! Siz: to'rt! Qiynalsangiz — barmoqlaringizga qarang. Siz o'nning haqiqiy do'stisiz!

lessons.name: Shar va kub
lessons.goal: Bola shar va kub shakllarini taniydi, ularning farqini aytadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men o'yinchoqlar qutisini ochdim. Ichida to'p va kubik bor. To'p nega dumalab ketadi-yu, kubik joyida turadi? Bu sirni birga ochamiz!

items.image_prompt: A colorful ball rolling on the floor, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — shar. Uning hech qayerida burchak ham, tekis joy ham yo'q — hamma tomoni dumaloq. Shuning uchun shar oson dumalaydi ⚽. Koptok, tarvuz 🍉, Yer shari 🌍 — hammasi sharga o'xshaydi.

items.image_prompt: A wooden toy cube with letters, a sugar cube, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — kub. Uning oltita tekis yuzi bor, har bir yuzi — kvadrat. Kubning burchaklari bor, shuning uchun u dumalamaydi, joyida turadi 🧊. O'yinchoq kubik, qand, muz bo'lagi — kubga o'xshaydi.

extra.matn: Stol ustiga koptok va o'yinchoq kubikni qo'ying. Ikkalasini ham barmoq bilan sekin itaring. Nima bo'ldi? Koptok dumalab ketdi, kubik esa sal siljidi-yu, to'xtadi. Chunki sharda burchak yo'q, kubda esa bor!

lessons.name: Silindr va konus
lessons.goal: Bola silindr va konus shakllarini taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Oshxonaga qarang: stakan, banka... Ko'chaga qarang: yo'l konusi, bayram qalpoqchasi... Bular ham shakllar ekan! Bugun ikki yangi shakl bilan tanishamiz.

items.uz: ikki tomoni tekis doira, yoni dumaloq
items.image_prompt: A tin can standing, a round pencil, a glass, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — silindr. Uning tepasida va pastida tekis doira bor, yon tomoni esa dumaloq. Tik qo'ysak — turadi, yotqizsak — dumalaydi! Banka 🥫, stakan, qalam silindrga o'xshaydi.

items.image_prompt: An ice cream cone, an orange traffic cone, a party hat, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — konus. Uning pastida tekis doira bor, tepasi esa uchli bo'lib tugaydi. Muzqaymoq voronkasi 🍦, yo'l konusi, bayram qalpoqchasi 🥳 — hammasi konus!
items.action: Qo'llaringizni boshingiz ustida uchli qilib birlashtiring!

tests.q: Qaysi shaklning ikki tomoni tekis doira?
tests.why: Zo'r! Silindrning tepasi ham, pasti ham doira.

extra.matn: Siz sotuvchisiz, men xaridor! Men aytaman: «Menga tepasi uchli narsa bering!» — siz konusni topasiz. «Menga yotqizsa dumalaydigan, tik qo'ysa turadigan narsa bering!» — silindr! «Hamma tomoni dumaloq narsa!» — shar! Rahmat, sotuvchi!

lessons.name: Dumalaydi yoki turadi
lessons.goal: Bola shakllarni xossasiga ko'ra ajratadi: dumalaydi, turadi, ikkalasi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Shakllar poyga o'tkazmoqchi! Ammo kim dumalab poygaga chiqa oladi, kim joyida qoladi? Qiya taxtachaga qo'yib ko'ramiz. Taxminingiz qanday?

items.image_prompt: A ball and a lying can rolling down a wooden slope, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Dumaloq yuzli shakllar dumalaydi. Shar har tomonga dumalaydi ⚽. Silindrni yotqizsak — u ham to'g'riga dumalaydi 🥫. Konus esa aylanib-aylanib dumalaydi.

items.image_prompt: A toy cube and a standing can staying still on a slope, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Tekis yuzli shakllar joyida turadi. Kubni qanday qo'ysangiz ham — turadi 🧊. Silindrni tik qo'ysak — u ham turadi. Shuning uchun uylar kubga o'xshash g'ishtdan quriladi 🧱!

tests.q: Qaysi shakl ham turadi, ham dumalaydi?
tests.why: Barakalla! Silindr tik tursa turadi, yotsa dumalaydi.
Zo'r! G'isht quti kabi tekis — turadi.

extra.matn: Kitobni bir tomonidan ko'tarib, qiya taxta yasang. Uning ustiga koptok, kubik, qalam va muzqaymoq voronkasini (yoki qog'oz konusni) qo'ying. Qaysilari pastga tushdi? Qaysi biri qoldi? Ota-onangizga natijani aytib bering!

lessons.name: Shakllar atrofimizda
lessons.goal: Bola atrofidagi narsalarda shar, kub, silindr, konusni topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bugun biz izquvar bo'lamiz! Uyda, ko'chada, bog'chada yashirinib olgan shakllarni topamiz. Lupani oling — qidiruvni boshladik!

items.image_prompt: A cozy room with a ball, a gift box, a glass and a party hat, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Uyda shakllar ko'p! Koptok — shar ⚽. Sovg'a qutisi — kub 🎁. Stakan — silindr 🥛. Bayram qalpoqchasi — konus 🥳. Xonangizga qarang: yana nimalar bor?

items.image_prompt: A toy castle built from cubes, cylinders towers and cone roofs, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Shakllardan qasr quramiz 🏰! Pastiga kublar qo'yamiz — ular mustahkam turadi. Minoralar uchun silindr, minoralar tepasiga esa konus — tom bo'ladi. Shar esa qasr oldida koptok bo'lib o'ynaydi!

tests.q: Qasr minorasining tepasiga qaysi shakl mos? 🏰

lessons.name: Haftaning boshlanishi
lessons.goal: Bola hafta 7 kundan iboratligini biladi, dushanba, seshanba, chorshanbani aytadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bilasizmi, kunlar ham oila bo'lib yashaydi! Ularning oilasi — hafta. Oilada nechta aka-uka bor ekan? Bugun birinchi uchtasi bilan tanishamiz.

items.image_prompt: A calendar page with seven colorful day boxes, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Hafta — bu yetti kun. Yetti kun o'tgach, hafta qaytadan boshlanadi. Esingizdami, kamalakda ham yetti rang bor edi 🌈? Haftada ham yetti kun!

items.image_prompt: A cheerful sun waking up, children going to kindergarten, badge with number one, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Dushanba — haftaning birinchi kuni. Dam olishdan keyin bog'chaga, ota-onalar ishga boradi. «Dush» — birinchi kun deb eslang!

items.image_prompt: Two calendar pages with numbers two and three and happy faces, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Seshanba — ikkinchi kun, chorshanba — uchinchi kun. Tartibni eslang: dushanba, seshanba, chorshanba. Sanoqqa o'xshaydi: bir, ikki, uch!

extra.matn: Hafta — poyezd, kunlar — vagonlar! «Chuh-chuh! Birinchi vagon — dushanba, ikkinchisi — seshanba, uchinchisi — chorshanba!» Bir-biringizning yelkangizdan ushlab, poyezd bo'lib yuring va vagonlarni sanang!

lessons.name: Payshanbadan yakshanbagacha
lessons.goal: Bola haftaning barcha 7 kunini tartib bilan aytadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Kunlar poyezdiga yana to'rtta vagon ulanishi kerak. Ular kim ekan? Ulardan ikkitasi — eng sevimli kunlar, chunki dam olamiz! Qaysilari ekan?

items.image_prompt: Two calendar pages with numbers four and five, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Payshanba — to'rtinchi kun, juma — beshinchi kun. Jumada ish haftasi tugaydi. Tartib: chorshanba, payshanba, juma.

items.image_prompt: A family having a picnic in the park on a sunny weekend, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Shanba — oltinchi kun, yakshanba — yettinchi, oxirgi kun. Ko'pchilik bu kunlari dam oladi 🧺: sayrga chiqamiz, mehmonga boramiz. Yakshanbadan keyin yana dushanba keladi!

items.image_prompt: A toy train with seven colorful wagons, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Endi butun haftani aytamiz: dushanba, seshanba, chorshanba, payshanba, juma, shanba, yakshanba! Har bir kun uchun bitta barmoq buking — yettita bo'ldi!

lessons.name: To'rt fasl
lessons.goal: Bola to'rt faslni nomlaydi va belgilarini aytadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men qushchaman, yil bo'yi tabiatni kuzataman. Goh qor yog'adi, goh gul ochiladi, goh issiq bo'ladi, goh barglar to'kiladi. Bu o'zgarishlar — fasllar! Nechta ekan?

items.image_prompt: Snowy landscape with a snowman and children in warm hats, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qish — eng sovuq fasl. Qor yog'adi ❄️, qordon yasaymiz, chana uchamiz. Issiq kiyim, qalpoq va qo'lqop kiyamiz 🧤.

items.image_prompt: Blooming trees, tulips and returning swallows, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bahor — uyg'onish fasli. Qor eriydi, daraxtlar gullaydi 🌸, qushlar qaytib keladi. Navro'z bayrami bahorda keladi!

items.image_prompt: Bright sun, children swimming, watermelon and cherries, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yoz — eng issiq fasl. Quyosh charaqlaydi ☀️, suvda cho'milamiz. Tarvuz, olcha, uzum pishadi 🍉.

items.image_prompt: Trees with yellow and orange falling leaves, apples, rain, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kuz — hosil fasli. Barglar sarg'ayib to'kiladi 🍂, yomg'ir yog'adi. Olma, anor, paxta terib olinadi. Kuzda bolalar maktabga boradi!

tests.why: Zo'r! Qish, bahor, yoz, kuz — to'rtta.

extra.matn: Men fasl aytaman — siz ko'rsatasiz! Qish — qaltirab, qo'llarni ishqalang. Bahor — gul bo'lib, qo'llarni ochib o'sing. Yoz — suzgandek qo'l siltang. Kuz — barg bo'lib, aylanib yerga tushing! Qish! Yoz! Kuz! Bahor!

lessons.name: Kecha, bugun, ertaga
lessons.goal: Bola fasllar ketma-ketligini va kecha-bugun-ertaga tushunchalarini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Fasllar ham, kunlar ham doira bo'lib aylanadi — biri ketadi, boshqasi keladi. Bugun vaqt g'ildiragini aylantiramiz. Qaysi fasl qaysidan keyin keladi?

items.image_prompt: A circle divided into four parts showing winter, spring, summer, autumn, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Fasllar doim bir tartibda keladi: qishdan keyin bahor, bahordan keyin yoz, yozdan keyin kuz, kuzdan keyin yana qish ❄️🌷☀️🍂. Xuddi aylanib turuvchi g'ildirakdek!

items.image_prompt: A calendar page with a big red circle around one day, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bugun — biz hozir yashayotgan kun. Bugun nima qildingiz? Bog'chaga keldingizmi, o'ynadingizmi? Hammasi — bugun!

items.image_prompt: Three calendar pages: a crossed-out one, a circled one, and one with a star, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kecha — bugundan oldingi, o'tib ketgan kun ⬅️. Ertaga — bugundan keyin keladigan kun ➡️. Agar bugun seshanba bo'lsa, kecha dushanba edi, ertaga esa chorshanba bo'ladi!

tests.q: Bugun juma. Kecha qaysi kun edi?

extra.matn: Kabutar qushcha so'raydi: «Kecha nima qilding?» Siz javob bering: «Kecha men ... o'ynadim». «Bugun-chi?» — «Bugun men ... ». «Ertaga nima qilasan?» — «Ertaga men ... qilaman». Ota-onangiz bilan ham shunday suhbatlashing!

lessons.name: Uzun va qisqa
lessons.goal: Bola ikki narsani uzunligi bo'yicha solishtiradi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Ikki ilon do'st bo'lib qolishdi. Biri: «Men uzunman!» deydi, ikkinchisi: «Men-chi?» deydi. Qanday bilamiz, kim uzun? Ularni yonma-yon yotqizamiz!

items.image_prompt: A very long green snake next to a short one, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ikki narsani yonma-yon qo'yamiz — boshlari bir joyda bo'lsin. Qaysi biri uzoqroqqa cho'zilsa — o'sha uzun. Uzun ilon 🐍, uzun poyezd 🚂, uzun sharf 🧣.

items.image_prompt: A short stubby pencil next to a long new pencil, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yonma-yon qo'yganda oldinroq tugaydigan narsa — qisqa. Ishlatilib kichrayib qolgan qalam — qisqa ✏️. Qisqa arqoncha, qisqa quyruq 🐇.

items.image_prompt: Two ribbons laid side by side starting at the same line, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: To'g'ri solishtirish uchun ikki narsaning boshini bir chiziqqa qo'yamiz. Aks holda, ko'zimiz aldanishi mumkin! Boshlar teng — endi uchlariga qaraymiz.

tests.q: Qaysi biri qisqa: yangi qalam yoki ishlatilgan kichkina qalam? ✏️
Ikki tasmani to'g'ri solishtirish uchun nima qilamiz?

lessons.name: Qadam bilan o'lchaymiz
lessons.goal: Bola masofani qadam bilan o'lchaydi va sanaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Xonadagi eshikdan derazagacha qancha yo'l bor? Bizda chizg'ich yo'q. Lekin oyoqlarimiz bor! Keling, qadam bilan o'lchaymiz — bu juda qiziq!

items.image_prompt: Child footprints in a row on the floor, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: O'lchash — bu nechta bir xil bo'lak sig'ishini sanash. Qadam tashlaymiz va sanaymiz: bir qadam, ikki qadam, uch qadam 👣. Eshikdan stolgacha nechta qadam bo'lsa — masofa shuncha!

items.uz: qadam soni katta bo'lsa, yo'l uzun
items.image_prompt: A long path with many footprints and a short path with few, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Agar bir yo'lga sakkiz qadam, boshqasiga uch qadam ketgan bo'lsa — sakkiz qadamli yo'l uzoqroq. Ko'p qadam — uzoq, kam qadam — yaqin!

items.image_prompt: A big elephant footprint and small mouse footprints, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Dadamning qadami katta, meniki kichik. Shuning uchun bir yo'lni dadam 4 qadamda, men 7 qadamda o'tdim 🐘🐭. To'g'ri o'lchash uchun bitta odam, bir xil qadam bilan o'lchashi kerak.

tests.q: Eshikkacha 5 qadam, derazagacha 8 qadam. Qaysi biri uzoq?
Fil 🐘 va sichqon 🐭 bir yo'lni o'tdi. Kim ko'p qadam tashlaydi?
tests.why: Ofarin! Sichqonning qadami kichik — ko'p qadam kerak.

extra.matn: Ota-onangiz bilan uyda o'lchang: oshxonadan yotoqxonagacha nechta qadam? Eshikdan divangacha-chi? Keyin dadangiz ham o'lchasin. Kimniki ko'p chiqdi? Nega? Chunki sizning qadamingiz kichik!

lessons.name: Qarich va ip bilan
lessons.goal: Bola narsalarni qarich va ip (chiziq) bilan o'lchaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Stol qancha uzun? Qadam bilan o'lchab bo'lmaydi — stol ustida yurmaymiz-ku! Unda qo'limiz va bir bo'lak ip yordamga keladi.

items.image_prompt: A child's hand stretched out measuring a table edge, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kaftni keng oching 🖐️: bosh barmoq bilan jimjiloq orasi — bu bir qarich. Stolga qarichni qo'yib, ketma-ket o'lchaymiz: bir, ikki, uch qarich. Stol necha qarich ekan?

items.image_prompt: A red string stretched along a book and a pencil, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Egri narsani qanday o'lchaymiz? Ipni uning bo'ylab qo'yamiz, keyin ipni to'g'rilab, boshqa narsa bilan solishtiramiz 🧵. Uzun ip — uzun narsa!

items.image_prompt: Two straight colored lines drawn on paper, one long one short, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qog'ozga qalam bilan chiziq chizamiz. Qalamni uzoq yurgizsak — uzun chiziq, ozgina yurgizsak — qisqa chiziq ✏️. Chiziqlarni ham boshini tenglab solishtiramiz.

tests.q: Bosh barmoq va jimjiloq orasi nima deyiladi? 🖐️
Stol 6 qarich, kursi 3 qarich. Qaysi biri uzun?
Egri yo'lni nima bilan o'lchash qulay?
Kitob 🖐️🖐️ ikki qarich, daftar 🖐️ bir qarich. Qaysi biri qisqa?

lessons.name: Og'ir va yengil
lessons.goal: Bola narsalarni og'irligi bo'yicha solishtiradi, tarozi ishini tushunadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men patchaman — juda yengilman, shamol meni uchirib ketadi! Filning esa og'irligi shunchalik ko'pki, uni hech kim ko'tarolmaydi. Og'ir va yengil — nima ekan?

items.image_prompt: A child trying to lift a big heavy watermelon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Og'ir narsani ko'tarish qiyin, u qo'lni pastga tortadi. Tarvuz 🍉, g'isht 🧱, fil 🐘 — og'ir. Katta chelak suv ham og'ir!

items.image_prompt: A feather and a balloon floating in the air, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yengil narsani ko'tarish oson. Pat 🪶, shar 🎈, qog'oz — yengil. Ularni hatto shamol ham uchirib ketadi!

items.image_prompt: A balance scale with a watermelon going down and an apple going up, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Tarozining ikki pallasi bor ⚖️. Og'ir narsa qo'yilgan palla pastga tushadi, yengil narsa pallasi tepaga ko'tariladi. Agar ikkalasi bir xil og'ir bo'lsa — tarozi teng turadi.

tests.q: Tarozining bir pallasi pastga tushdi. U yerdagi narsa qanday?

extra.matn: Ikki qo'lingizni tarozi pallasidek oldinga cho'zing. Bir qo'lga olma, ikkinchisiga yong'oq qo'ying. Qaysi qo'l pastga tortyapti? O'sha narsa og'ir! Endi kitob va qalamni solishtiring. Ota-onangizga natijani aytib bering!

lessons.name: Labirint
lessons.goal: Bola labirintdan chiqish yo'lini topadi, o'ng va chapni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Kichkina sichqoncha pishloq hidini sezdi, lekin ular orasida chalkash yo'llar — labirint bor! Unga yo'l topishga yordam beramizmi?

items.image_prompt: A cute mouse at the entrance of a simple garden maze with cheese at the exit, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Labirint — ko'p burilishli yo'llar. Ba'zi yo'llar devorga taqalib qoladi — bu berk yo'l. Barmog'imiz bilan yo'lni kuzatamiz; berk yo'lga kirsak, orqaga qaytib boshqasini sinaymiz 🐭🧀.

items.image_prompt: A child raising right hand, arrow pointing right, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: O'ng qo'lingizni ko'taring — bu o'ng tomon 👉. Ko'pchilik o'ng qo'l bilan qoshiq ushlaydi. Labirintda «o'ngga burilamiz» desak — o'ng qo'l tomonga ketamiz.

items.image_prompt: A child raising left hand, arrow pointing left, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Chap qo'lingizni ko'taring — bu chap tomon 👈. Yuragimiz chap tomonda uradi ❤️. «Chapga burilamiz» desak — chap qo'l tomonga ketamiz.

tests.q: Labirintda yo'l devorga taqaldi. Nima qilamiz?
tests.why: To'g'ri! Orqaga qaytib, boshqa yo'lni sinaymiz.

extra.matn: Siz — robot, men — boshqaruvchi! «Ikki qadam oldinga! O'ngga buril! Bir qadam oldinga! Chapga buril! To'xta!» Robot faqat buyruq bilan yuradi. Endi siz buyruq bering, ota-onangiz robot bo'lsin!

lessons.name: Strelkalar yo'li
lessons.goal: Bola strelkalar bo'yicha yo'lni kuzatadi: yuqoriga, pastga, o'ngga, chapga
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men xazina xaritasini topdim! Unda so'z yo'q, faqat strelkalar chizilgan. Strelkalar ko'rsatgan tomonga yursak — xazinani topamiz! Qani, ketdik!

items.image_prompt: A child pointing up at a bird and down at a flower, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yuqoriga — tepaga, osmon tomonga ⬆️. Pastga — yer tomonga ⬇️. Qushlar yuqorida uchadi, gullar pastda o'sadi. Qo'lingizni yuqoriga ko'taring, endi pastga tushiring!

items.image_prompt: Colorful arrows pointing in four directions on a treasure map, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Strelka qaysi tomonga qarasa, o'sha tomonga yuramiz. ➡️ — o'ngga, ⬅️ — chapga, ⬆️ — yuqoriga, ⬇️ — pastga. Har bir strelka — bitta qadam!

items.image_prompt: A treasure map with a dotted path made of arrows leading to a chest, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Xaritada strelkalar qatori: ➡️➡️⬆️. Demak: ikki qadam o'ngga, bir qadam yuqoriga. Har strelkani barmoq bilan ko'rsatib, sanab boramiz — adashmaymiz! 🏴‍☠️

extra.matn: Ota-onangiz xonada o'yinchoqni yashirsin va qog'ozga strelkalar chizsin: ⬆️⬆️⬆️ ➡️➡️. Siz strelkalar bo'yicha qadam tashlaysiz: uch qadam oldinga, ikki qadam o'ngga. Xazinani topdingizmi? Barakalla, kapitan!

lessons.name: Ortiqchasini top
lessons.goal: Bola guruhdagi boshqalarga o'xshamaydigan narsani topadi va sababini aytadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Mevalar savatiga kimdir ayyorlik qilib bir narsa tashlab ketibdi. U mevalarga o'xshamaydi! Ortiqcha mehmonni topamiz va nega ortiqcha ekanini aytamiz.

items.image_prompt: A basket with an apple, a pear, a banana and a grape, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Guruh — bir-biriga o'xshash narsalar. Olma, nok, banan — mevalar guruhi 🍎🍐🍌. Shar, kub, konus — shakllar guruhi. Nimasi o'xshashligini topamiz: rangi, shakli yoki turi.

items.image_prompt: A basket of fruits with a toy car inside looking out of place, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ortiqcha — guruhga o'xshamaydigan narsa. 🍎🍐🍌🚗 — mashina ortiqcha, chunki u meva emas! Ortiqchani topgach, har doim «nega?» degan savolga javob beramiz.

tests.why: Ofarin! Kub dumaloq emas, qolganlari sharga o'xshaydi.

extra.matn: Men uchta so'z aytaman — qaysi biri ortiqcha va nega? «Qish, yoz, dushanba» — dushanba, chunki u fasl emas, kun! «Uch, besh, olma» — olma, chunki u son emas! Endi siz menga topishmoq tuzing!

lessons.name: Mantiqiy qatorlar
lessons.goal: Bola takrorlanuvchi qatorning qoidasini topib, keyingi elementni aytadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men munchoq teryapman: qizil, sariq, qizil, sariq... Voy, keyingisini unutdim! Siz yordam bering — bu qatorning sirli qoidasi bor!

items.image_prompt: A string of beads alternating red and yellow, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mantiqiy qatorda narsalar bir qoida bilan takrorlanadi. 🔴🟡🔴🟡 — qizil, sariq, qizil, sariq. Qoida: qizil, keyin sariq! Demak keyingisi — qizil 🔴.

items.image_prompt: A row of animals: cat dog cat dog and an empty spot with a question mark, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qatorni ovoz chiqarib aytamiz: «mushuk, it, mushuk, it...» — quloq ham qoidani eshitadi! 🐈🐕🐈🐕❓ Keyingisi — mushuk. Qator uzun bo'lsa ham, qoida o'sha.

items.image_prompt: Number cards one two three four five in a row on a string, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sonlardan ham qator bo'ladi: 1, 2, 3, 4 — har biri bittaga ko'p, keyingisi — 5. Orqaga: 5, 4, 3 — keyingisi 2. Esingizdami, qo'shni sonlar? Ular yordam beradi!

tests.why: Ofarin! Har biri bittaga ko'p — olti.
Zo'r! Qoida: shar, kub, kub — keyingisi kub.

extra.matn: Harakatlardan qator tuzamiz! Qarsak, sakrash, qarsak, sakrash... Keyingisi nima? Qarsak! Endi qiyinroq: qarsak, qarsak, o'tirish; qarsak, qarsak, o'tirish... Keyingisi? Qarsak! Siz mantiq ustasisiz! Gu-gu!
